# POST /api/v1/packages/{owner}/{type}/{name}/-/link/{repo_name}

Link a package to a repository

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-206`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| type | path | string | True |
| name | path | string | True |
| repo_name | path | string | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**201** — empty

- **400** — Package already linked to a repository
- **403** — User lacks write access to packages unit on repo, or owner mismatch
- **404** — Package or repository not found

## Workflow

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [services](../modules/services.md) | context.PackageAssignmentAPI | controller | Resolve user; Determine access mode |
| 2 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | packages.LinkPackage | controller | Get package by name; Get repository by name; Call LinkToRepository service |
| 3 | [services](../modules/services.md) | packages_service.LinkToRepository | service | Validate pkg.OwnerID == repo.OwnerID; Validate pkg.RepoID == 0; Check doer has write access to TypePackages on repo; Set repository link |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Package access requires at least read permission; write operations require write access or site admin | authorization | ctx.Package.AccessMode < accessMode && !ctx.IsUserSiteAdmin() |
| LinkPackage requires package owner and repository owner to be the same | validation | pkg.OwnerID != repo.OwnerID |
| LinkPackage requires package to not already be linked to a repository | validation | pkg.RepoID > 0 |
| LinkPackage requires doer to have write access to TypePackages unit on the target repository | authorization | !perms.CanWrite(unit.TypePackages) |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| Package or repo not found | 404 | notFound | False |
| Package already linked | 400 | bad request | False |
| Owner mismatch or no write access | 403 | forbidden | False |

### Error Paths

- **Package not found** → LinkPackage → 404
- **Repository not found** → LinkPackage → 404
- **Package already linked (RepoID > 0)** → LinkPackage → 400
- **Owner mismatch or no write permission** → LinkPackage → 403
